mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_warehouse (warehouse_code, warehouse_name, location, manager_id, manager_name, status, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{warehouseCode}, #{warehouseName}, #{location}, #{managerId}, #{managerName}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

mapper.delete: UPDATE t_warehouse SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
